items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had met him when I was with Lena, years ago when I was with Lena and then I saw him, you know, from time to time, you know. ... No previous relationship. I just signed with him.

ctx.x: That’s good. I mean, yeah, the last time I talked to George he talked a lot about, you know, his relationship with Miles, you know, and why he did certain things and wouldn’t do certain things with Miles.
Man, I got to tell you , when I signed with Reprise -- oh, I just read George Jacobs book. Do you know who George Jacobs was?
